snippet.title: Your Friends Can't Be Trusted With Money | Gamble Hunters
snippet.description:
One shared wallet. Four very different ideas of how to spend it.

Play the FREE demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5117630/Gamble_Hunters/

Gamble Hunters is a casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. Hunt monsters in 60-second rounds, hit the casino, and upgrade your gear before the next debt payment.

The hunting money is shared. Casino winnings are yours. The debt? Everybody's problem.

Bring up to 3 friends, or go solo and have no one else to blame.

Try the demo, wishlist the full game, and tell us: who's the LAST friend you'd trust with the wallet?

#GambleHunters #coopgaming  #indiegame
